record.dic_text:
01737 Dowday {do:-dai'}

與 01736 同型; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Dodai 1; 1

朵代 = "情愛的" 或 "戀慕的"
1) 負責第二個月的王室服事的亞哈希人; 可能等同於'朵多' 01734
   (#代上 27:4|)
record.edic_text:
01737 Dowday {do-dah'ee}

formed like 01736;; n pr m

AV - Dodai 1; 1

Dodai = "loving" or "amorous"
1) an Ahohite who commanded the course of the second month; probably
   the same as 'Dodo'
